title: You don't need the Hill Country
why: Brand belief for Houston families who drive hours for nature: the bayou is the destination, not the backup plan. Takes the side of Houston against 'there's nothing to do here'.
hook_options: You don't need the Hill Country
"There's nothing to do in Houston." Wrong.
A heron is standing three miles from downtown right now
caption: Every weekend Houston families drive three hours to find nature. Meanwhile there's a heron standing three miles from downtown. The bayou isn't the backup plan. It isn't crystal-blue water either. It's alive, it's flat, families do fine, and it's in your backyard. #houston #buffalobayou #urbannature #buffalobayoukayak

slides.headline: You don't need the Hill Country
slides.body: Every weekend Houston families drive three hours to find nature. A heron is standing three miles from downtown right now.

slides.headline: "There's nothing to do here."
slides.body: It's also the most wrong. Most of us just never look down from the bridge.

slides.headline: Turtles. Herons. Egrets. Downtown.
slides.body: The bayou cuts straight through the city, full of life most people drive right over.

slides.headline: The bayou isn't the backup plan
slides.body: It's not the cheap version of a real outdoor trip. A heron in the middle of Houston beats one in the Hill Country, because nobody expected it.

slides.headline: Same city. Zero traffic.
slides.body: Dave H. on TripAdvisor: "So much more peaceful being down on the water than fighting all the traffic on the bridges and roadways above."

slides.headline: It's not crystal-blue water
slides.body: It's a working urban waterway. But herons, turtles and 300,000 bats don't stick around unless the place is alive.

slides.headline: The "I had no idea this was here" moment
slides.body: That's what we're actually selling. The kayak is just the tool.

slides.headline: Flat water. Families welcome.
slides.body: No expedition, no fitness test. Kids 6 and up get their own seat with an adult along.

slides.headline: Don't argue. Hand them a paddle.
slides.body: When someone says Houston has no nature, put them in a kayak three miles from downtown and let a heron make the point.

slides.kicker: Tag the friend who says Houston's boring
slides.headline: Your backyard has a bayou
slides.body: Tours and rentals from Allen's Landing, open daily. Book at buffalobayoukayak.com.
